session.no_image: the computer is not sending a picture (its encoder is not responding: see its console's log, System › Logs)
session.unauthorized: the computer's server does not recognise this device's account yet: in the console, restart the server (System), then try again
session.tls: the certificate of the computer's server does not match the one given by the console
session.image_refused: the computer rejected the picture request
session.not_responding: the computer is no longer responding
session.no_display: no usable display on the computer

update.other_key: manifest signed with a key other than KyberNow's
update.invalid_signature: invalid manifest signature: tampered or damaged version
update.version_mismatch: the signed manifest announces {manifest} but GitHub publishes {version}
update.file_missing: {file} is missing from the signed manifest of version {version}
update.tampered: downloaded file differs from the signed manifest: damaged or tampered with
